newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor falls on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: India castor falls on speculative selling.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery lost the gained ground and dropped from 1,191/1,192 rupees to 1,183/1,184 rupees per quintal on renewed speculative selling, floor sources said.
"Overseas buying was low while higher new crop arrivals prompted bull liquidation," one dealer said.
March delivery remained untraded as outstanding positions were squared up and major players have turned to June delivery.
New crop arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region rose today to 50,000/60,000 bags (75 kg each) against earlier daily average of 25,000/30,000 bags.
Groundnut oil was steady at 342/343 rupees per 10 kg amid limited activity. In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 515/516 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay imported palm-oil slid from 285 rupees to 283 rupees per 10 kg as higher prices attracted profit-taking following weak trend in the world market.
"Palm-oil prices in the world market suffered a setback on fears that India may hike import duty on the edible oil," one miller said.
India is a major consumer of imported palm-oil.
